content: Phase 2C: Twilio SMS + SendGrid Email integration
Stash Twilio + SendGrid creds in backend/.env
Build /app/backend/notifications.py — central SMS+Email dispatch with audit logging
Twilio SMS #1: Crash auto-text on CrashGuardian confirmed crash
Twilio SMS #2: Dispatch SMS endpoint (admin -> driver)
Twilio SMS #3: Roadside auto-text to provider on dispatch
Twilio SMS #4: HOS warning SMS endpoint (manual + auto-trigger ready)
SendGrid Email #4: DVIR signed copy auto-emailed to admin
Admin /app/notifications page — audit log UI w/ filters
Fix seed phones to valid E.164 + force re-seed
Run backend testing agent on full notification surface
